description:
Cash a resolved position: the winning side pays 1 sat per share, the losing side pays nothing, and BOTH are burned.

Only callable after the market resolves. Redeeming burns the whole position in one call, so there is nothing left to redeem a second time.

Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: atstake_redeem
